Terms & Conditions

Srinivasa Enterprises

These Terms & Conditions govern all business transactions and use of services provided by Srinivasa Enterprises. By placing an order, requesting a quotation, or engaging in business with us, you agree to these terms.

1. Product Quality

  • Srinivasa Enterprises supplies products as per agreed specifications.
  • As agricultural products are natural, slight variations in size, color, and quality may occur.

2. Pricing

  • All prices are subject to market fluctuations.
  • Final pricing will be confirmed through a Proforma Invoice before order confirmation.

3. Payment Terms

  • We accept Advance Payment and Letter of Credit (LC at sight).
  • Payment terms shall be mutually agreed upon with the buyer.

4. Shipment & Delivery

  • Shipments are made under FOB (Free On Board) or CIF/CNF (Cost, Insurance & Freight) terms.
  • Delivery timelines depend on product availability and shipping schedules.

5. Packaging

  • Standard export packaging is provided.
  • Customized packaging can be arranged based on buyer requirements at additional cost.

6. Documentation

  • Commercial Invoice
  • Packing List
  • Bill of Lading / Airway Bill
  • Phytosanitary Certificate
  • Other export documents as required

7. Claims & Complaints

  • Any claims regarding quality or quantity must be reported within 48 hours of delivery.
  • Claims should include supporting evidence and documentation.

8. Force Majeure

  • Srinivasa Enterprises shall not be responsible for delays caused by natural disasters, government regulations, strikes, transportation disruptions, or other unforeseen circumstances.

9. Governing Law

  • All transactions are governed by the laws of India.
  • Any disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Indian courts.
